item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wants to find out whether warm or cold conditions change the speed at which water moves up a plant stem.
She places two similar cut hibiscus twigs in glasses of red-coloured water.
Which plan is a fair test?

options.A: Put one twig in a warm room and the other in a cold room, keeping the amount of coloured water, the size of the twigs and the light the same in both.
options.B: Put a long twig in cold water and a short twig in warm water, then see which twig turns red at the top first.
options.C: Put one twig in red ink and the other in plain water, both in the same warm room, then compare the colours.
options.D: Put a rose twig in the sun and a mango twig in the shade, then measure how much water each one absorbs.
